R109_post_write_completion_gate.rule: A fix script is complete only after the written file is read back and the file contains every required post-patch marker: the new function definition, the required call site, any type-safe replacements, and the completion marker. If any marker is missing, the script must fail closed and stop.
R109_post_write_completion_gate.problem: Previous patch scripts passed syntax checks but still left runtime omissions, including a missing showloadingscreen implementation and an Array[String] type mismatch.
R109_post_write_completion_gate.detector: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; s=Path('build_terrain.gd').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); req=['func showloadingscreen','showloadingscreen(','Array[String]','IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE']; print('PASS' if all(x in s for x in req) else 'FAIL')"
R109_post_write_completion_gate.verification: Run the script, then read the file back. All required markers must be present in the saved file before the build is considered done.
